sfxPulseVolume.description: Sound Wave's rounded pulse sits below short attack sounds.

sfxRoutineCutoff.description: Low-pass cutoff for repeated attacks and pickups; music has no filter.

cameraWorldWidth.description: Visible world width across portrait phones and the editor's portrait frame. Larger values zoom out.

cashBundleRadius.description: Settled bills this close combine into a fixed stack, preserving every cash and XP reward.

dropTargetPace.description: Required fan charms during the song, as a fraction of the pre-song charm pace.

dropSpawnMult.description: Everyone's streaming it: extra fans arrive while the single is charting.

openingSideEntrySeconds.description: Fans enter from the sides near the idol's height while learning to collect cash.

firstUpgradeBreatherSeconds.description: Brief protection and a break in regular spawns after choosing the first upgrade.

swarmDepth.description: Outward depth stagger for swarms spread around the camera perimeter.

autoTargetScreenInset.description: Fans must be this far inside the camera view before attacks can target or charm them.

minHitInterval.description: Minimum seconds between two hits on the player, whatever the crowd size.

fanHitCooldown.description: Seconds before the same fan can hit you again.

cashMagnetRadius.description: Cash starts flying to the idol only inside this range. Cash Magnet and Summer multiply it.

grandmaMilkDropChance.description: Chance that a charmed Turbo Grandma leaves Yakult.

firstRecoveryDropTime.description: After this time, the next visible fan charmed drops Yakult if no bottle has been shown yet.

recoveryPickupDelay.description: Seconds a Yakult bottle rests before it can be attracted or collected, so its drop is visible.

openingLevelFollowers.description: XP costs after the first choice. Later costs grow from the last listed value.

hypeDropFansMin.description: Charmed fans between gold Hype drops, drawn again after each drop.

hypePickupDelay.description: Seconds a gold Hype pickup rests before attraction or collection.

regularGroupSize.description: Regular fans enter together in small groups, using the same per-fan arrival budget.

spawnCurve.description: Shape of the spawn ramp from start to end rate: 1 = linear, higher = gentler start and steeper finish.

forwardSpawnChance.description: After the opening side entries, this fraction of regular fans approaches from ahead of movement.

forwardSpawnAngleDegrees.description: Full angular spread of travel-facing entries. Every entry remains outside the camera frame.

charmGrowthLinear.description: Fan charm meters grow by linear * minutes + quadratic * minutes^2.

charmGrowthDelay.description: Keep the first choices approachable, then grow fan charm meters as the loadout develops.

fanScalingSecondsPerLevel.description: Cap health/contact scaling by earned levels so slow XP collection cannot create a health-growth stalemate.

fanScalingOverflowFraction.description: Time scaling continues at this fraction after reaching the level-based ceiling.

damageGrowthPerMinute.description: Fan contact damage grows by this fraction per minute survived.

crowdAreaRadius.description: Nearby ground shares a local crowd. As it thins, arrivals slow toward the quiet-area rate.

crowdAreaRefillSeconds.description: Seconds away for an emptied area to refill. Returning sooner finds a quieter patch.

crowdAreaQuietRate.description: Fraction of the normal arrival rate retained in a cleared area; follows the run's pacing and Hype.

ultChargeGrowth.description: Each use raises the next charge requirement by this factor, so Showstopper stays a big moment.

faintSeconds.description: Seconds for a quick happy hop, twirl and heart-eyed swoon, then a short fade. Dads use the same timing; the Rival Idol takes 20% longer. Cash drops immediately when the fan is charmed.

photocardSpin.description: Visible card rotation in degrees per second; hearts remain upright.

confettiTickSeconds.description: One charm tick per fan, shared by all overlapping confetti patches.

fanSpeechInterval.description: Gameplay seconds between ordinary fan speech balloons.

tourClearRivals.description: Unlock the next tour after this many rivals; the current match keeps going.

scenerySpacing.description: World-space distance between sparse, solid landmarks. Wide lanes remain open between them.
